title: Private Monetary Stack
question: How do regulated money, tokenized assets, identity, messaging, custody, merchant acceptance and settlement connect without becoming one unified ledger?
bluf: The vault-canonical map of firms and product lines that connect regulated money, tokenized assets, card credentials, merchant acceptance, identity, messaging, custody and settlement without becoming one unified ledger. The transparency extension shows that stablecoins can expose a public transfer record while reserves, beneficial ownership, direct redemption, complete cost, legal finality and remedy remain institutionally governed. The accounting extension now has a full-thesis front door: legal and economic meaning, signed events, purpose-specific official records, versioned rules, judgment objects, continuous subledgers, reporting, control, assurance and remedy remain separate layers across sixteen accounting functions, eight business cycles, multiple legitimate views, eight clocks and an evidence ladder. Oracle–Swift, smart contracts, blockchain recordkeeping and continuous-assurance tools are placed as bounded mechanisms and early evidence gates rather than treated as the transition itself. A targeted September 3 refresh records OCC preliminary conditional approval for proposed World Liberty Trust Company, N.A.; the bank still cannot commence business before final approval, and its planned USD1 transfer from BitGo remains future-state. A bounded September 15 state-credit-union audit finds a real Florida/Wyoming public-deposit seam and an explicit possible Wyoming stable-token connection, but no enacted state-owned credit union, 0–3 percent lending program or demonstrated credit-union role in either digital-money chain. The bounded September 23 SEC 24-hour-trading return finds a scheduled 23x5 expansion rather than live 24x7 operation: execution, market data and clearing availability are lengthening on different clocks while issuer disclosure, corporate actions, supervision, cash and finality remain separate boundaries. The September 24 Fed/CFTC work adds a page-complete 452-page reading of the proposed Board-supervised stablecoin issuer constitution and bank-subsidiary application gateway plus current CFTC staff guidance for tokenized eligible assets and on-chain records; the Fed architecture is projected through its own seven-layer, twelve-gate Hub rather than treated as one flat rule overlay. The September 30 OUSD launch return identifies Bridge Building Inc. as issuer and redemption obligor, Open Standard as the partner-economics and prospective governance company, and Mastercard as a founding investor and advertised access route after completing BVNK; four-chain supply and the issuer reserve dashboard are live, while a Mastercard customer receipt, independent monthly attestation and published consortium constitution remain open.
evidence_cutoff_note: Keep the broad package frozen through August 26. Name the bounded September 3 World Liberty preliminary-conditional-approval refresh, September 7 Kraken charter-consummation correction, September 8 GENIUS implementation delta, September 15 state-credit-union/public-deposit audit, September 23 SEC 24-hour-trading proceeding return, September 24 Fed/CFTC stablecoin-tokenization delta and September 30 OUSD launch return separately; none refreshes the rest of the package.
use_note: Internal recall for named entity, product, adapter, licensing and bounded accounting/transparency claims. World Liberty is refreshed only to preliminary conditional OCC approval through September 3; final approval, commencement, the planned USD1 transfer and operating state remain unproven. Dynamic totals and single-network or token-control inference remain outside this item. Kraken is refreshed only through September 7 for charter consummation/correction; do not infer Federal Reserve access, universal operating readiness or refresh of unrelated product states. For the SEC roundtable, treat captions as discovery evidence and separate current overnight operation, the scheduled December 6 23x5 gate and later 24x7 proposals; no panelist statement by itself proves Commission adoption or an integrated securities-and-cash settlement rail. For OUSD, keep Bridge issuer/reserve/redemption control, Open Standard corporate economics/governance, Mastercard distribution and the four token contracts separate; launch supply is not customer payment volume, and the real-time reserve page is not the first independent monthly attestation.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
